'''Henna''' was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Artisan/Legends|jeweler]] who ran the jewellery company [[Bothawui Jewellers]]<ref name="TJoY" /> at some point between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="Timeframe">The events of ''[[The Jewel of Yavin]]'' took place while [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] was [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], a period which started in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] and ended in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> The business was set up on the floating [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colony of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], in the [[Market Row]] commercial corridor in Cloud [[City/Legends|City's]] [[Port Town (Cloud City)/Legends|Port Town]] district. Henna was [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to another Bothan jeweler named [[Cidri]], and the pair operated the business together out of a weathered [[JumpMaster 5000/Legends|JumpMaster 5000]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]].<ref name="TJoY" />

==Behind the scenes==
Henna first appeared in ''[[The Jewel of Yavin]]'', an adventure module released in [[2014]] for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' roleplaying game. The jeweler is listed as a merchant players can purchase goods from, but no specific interactions are listed.<ref name="TJoY" />
